elements.description:
Exhibits linked to a matter – reference, title, type, source with its grade, date, holder and status – each opening
onto its chain of custody with the hash at every step.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the list's name

properties.name: exhibits
properties.description: The exhibits, in the order given

properties.name: statuses
properties.description: The statuses, merged over the defaults (sealed, analysis, pending, transcribed, released)

properties.name: synced
properties.description: When the list was last synced, epoch ms – shown in the header

properties.name: note
properties.description: A quiet line above the list, e.g. where the originals are kept

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The open exhibit's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: An exhibit was opened or closed ({ selected, exhibit }: EvidenceSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: A hash's Copy was pressed ({ exhibit, hash }: EvidenceCopy); cancelable – prevented, the element doesn't copy

functions.name: defaultExhibitStatuses
functions.description: The statuses used when the page gives none

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the list's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The open exhibit's id – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The exhibit open on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: An exhibit was opened or closed; `exhibit` is the opened one

props.name: onCopyHash
props.description: A hash's Copy was pressed; return false to copy it yourself instead

changelog: **evidence-list:** hashes are compared as digests (case, spaces, prefix spelling); different algorithms read "Hashes not compared", not a mismatch.

**People & profiles:** - `tc-entity-timeline`: events by month, each with a category and a graded source, filtered by category. - `tc-travel-itinerary`: legs with mode, document, confidence and flags, grouped into journeys. - `tc-place-list`: places with type, status, coordinates and dates. - `tc-account-list`: masked IBAN-style accounts with a status and the page's own stats. - `tc-money-flow`: transfers between entities as bands sized by amount, with flag chips. - Entities' and transfers' flows are lit with a readout, and there's a table view. - `tc-co-occurrence`: entities ranked by the events they share with a subject. - Strength in words and bars, with counts per source. - `tc-evidence-list`: exhibits, each opening onto its chain of custody, with hash agreement. - `tc-asset-list`: grouped assets with masked identifiers and a status. - `tc-contact-channels`: emails, phone numbers, messaging and addresses. - Masked until shown, with role, last use and verification.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
